findings.title: Missing sanctioned answers silently count as scored
findings.why_it_matters: A rules-enabled eval can report a finding as scored even when the provider omits the sanctioned answer, leaving the policy measurement incomplete without a malformed-answer warning. Unlike the other requested answers validated at lines 412–415, this answer silently becomes null; require a valid sanctioned.noul when rules were supplied so the existing unscored-finding path exposes the failed measurement.
findings.first_evidence: .agents/skills/ai-review-report/scripts/lib/score-findings-decisions.sh:427 -- sanctioned: (if $has_rules and ($a.sanctioned.noul | prob) then $a.sanctioned.noul else null end),
